svg.title: Nine DevSecOps stages covered by Probation + Undertaker
svg.desc: Plan: census:collect, census:file, undertaker:dig. Create: Undertaker flow (exhume, bury, coroner). Verify: verify:check, verify:replay. Package: package:image, catalog-sync. Verify also runs validate-items. Secure: SAST, Secret Detection, Dependency Scanning, secure:npm-audit. Release: release:plan, release:run, deploy:staging, approve:production, deploy:canary, promote:production, govern:release-notes. Configure: ci/deploy.sh and ci/gcp-auth.sh. Monitor: soak:canary, measure:sci, rollback:production. Govern: probation:gate, settle jobs, probation:sweep, govern:baseline, pages.

text.font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, 'DejaVu Serif', serif
'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Bold names are CI jobs, spelled exactly as in .gitlab-ci.yml and the generated release child pipeline. Plain names are flows, templates and files.

g.text: the ledger’s level decides how far the next burial goes alone; do-not-bury stops the census
